ov: هاتف خلوي (الإنجليزية: cellular)، هو فيلم إثارة، حركة، جريمة أمريكي أنتج سنة 2004 من إخراج ديفيد آر.أليس، ومن بطولة جيسون ستاثام وكريس إيفانز وكيم بايسنجر.
plotEn:
Science teacher Jessica Martin lives with her husband Craig and son Ricky. One morning, intruders break into their home, killing their housekeeper and kidnapping Jessica. They lock her in an attic, smashing the landline. She wires the broken phone to try to connect to someone.
She manages to connect to Ryan, a laid-back, immature young man hanging with friends at Santa Monica Pier. Although believing Jessica is pranking him, he goes to the police. When a fight erupts at the station, he is sent upstairs to report the kidnapping. However, worsening cell service on the way up forces him to stop so he doesn't lose Jessica on the call. 
Lead kidnapper Ethan Greer demands Jessica reveal Craig's location. When she refuses, he goes after Ricky. Overhearing Ethan threatening Jessica, Ryan realises the kidnapping is real, which sobers him. He is unable to prevent Ricky's abduction. Due to low phone battery, he uses a gun from a security officer's car to skip the store line and quickly obtain a phone charger.
Investigating Ryan's claim, Officer Mooney visits Jessica's home. One of Ethan's accomplices, Dana Bayback, poses as Jessica. When Ethan returns with Ricky, Jessica helplessly reveals that Craig is at an LAX bar.
